نجتلي (form VIII)
# نَجْتَلِي (najtalī) /nad͡ʒ.ta.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# نَجْتَلِيَ (najtaliya) /nad͡ʒ.ta.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
